name: Leagle - Turkish Law
description: Leagle connects Claude to a searchable, daily-updated index of Turkish legal sources. It lets you search legal documents by keyword and filter, and retrieve the full text of specific statutes or case law. Useful for legal research, case lookup, and quickly finding the most current, relevant text of Turkish laws and rulings without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Leagle - Turkish Law to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Leagle - Turkish Law to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.leagleapp.com/mcp/tr. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Leagle - Turkish Law MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leagle - Turkish Law provides these MCP tools: get_document_details, list_legal_sources, and search_legal_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Leagle - Turkish Law?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Leagle - Turkish Law in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does Leagle - Turkish Law MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leagle - Turkish Law requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Leagle - Turkish Law is developed by Leagle Teknoloji Anonim Şirketi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
